content: React team no longer recommends useEffect as the primary data-fetching mechanism (race conditions, no cancellation, waterfalls) but full use()+Suspense replacement pulls in more architecture than needed for a 2-route SPA over a tiny (<=16 item) catalog. React Router 7 Data Mode loaders are the pragmatic middle ground: fetch happens outside component render, parallel with navigation, error boundaries via errorElement, no manual loading-state boilerplate per component.
